environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at the instance via nginx. No additional middleware or filtering. The application is accessed directly via the NLB DNS endpoint. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume.
